summary.business_type: D2C e-commerce (WooCommerce): wine tasting game boxes, B2B gifts, on-location tastings; nl-NL primary with partial /de/ section
top_findings: Server response time of 3 to 7 seconds on every page; lab LCP 5.0 s on the mobile homepage. Cache-Control max-age=0 plus WooCommerce session and __cvg_1p_uid cookies on anonymous requests defeat page caching.
No Product, Offer, AggregateRating or Review schema on any product page, so Merchant listings and star ratings are unreachable despite a 4.5-star Trustpilot rating shown on page.
Every unknown URL 301-redirects to the homepage; 26 legacy product URLs linked 287 times from 114 pages and the privacy policy URL all land on the homepage.
No hreflang on 208 pages; /de/, /en/ and /nl redirect to the Dutch homepage; 60 of 96 German URLs resolve to Dutch pages; /en/shop/ declares en-US but serves Dutch.

Index bloat: 9 homepage test clones, 14 German -kopie product clones, 7 kerstcadeau landing variants, duplicated posts, 22 thin ?reviews=/?store= pages; 46 of 120 sitemap URLs are junk and the author sitemap has an invalid <loc>#</loc>.
quick_wins: Enable full-page caching with the WooCommerce session cookie excluded from the cache key outside cart/checkout; fix Cache-Control and Expires headers.
Switch on WooCommerce/Yoast Product structured data and add AggregateRating from Trustpilot (JSON-LD provided in findings/schema.md).
Restore /privacybeleid/ and retarget the 26 legacy URLs to their real products, then fix the 287 internal links.
Trash or 301 the test pages, German clones and kerstcadeau variants; noindex ?reviews=/?store= and geen-categorie; disable the author sitemap.
Add H1s and meta descriptions to /shop/, the product pages, /flavory-gameplay/, /wijnkiezer/, the B2B page and /proeverij/; add 'wijnbox' and 'wijnproeverij thuis' to titles.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Server-rendered HTML, no JavaScript rendering dependency
www and http correctly 301 to https://flavory.wine
Valid robots.txt and valid sitemap index with 8 child sitemaps
Viewport meta present on all pages; cart pages noindexed

findings.title: Catch-all 301 to homepage instead of 404 (soft-404 pattern)
findings.description: Any unknown path returns 301 to https://flavory.wine/. 26 legacy product/landing URLs still linked 287 times from 114 pages land on the homepage; /privacybeleid/ is swallowed too.
findings.recommendation: Serve real 404s with a helpful template; retarget each legacy URL to its live product (map in findings/ecommerce.md); update internal links.

findings.title: No hreflang and broken language roots
findings.description: 0 of 208 pages carry hreflang. /de/, /en/, /nl 301 to the Dutch homepage; the German home is /de/start/. 60 of 96 German URLs resolve to Dutch pages via redirect or canonical. /en/shop/ and /en/blog/ declare en-US but serve Dutch.
findings.recommendation: Point /de/ to /de/start/; add hreflang nl/de/x-default only for translated pairs; noindex or remove the /en/ pages unless an English site is planned.

findings.title: Index bloat: about 40% of crawled URLs should not be indexable
findings.description: 9 builder test pages duplicating the homepage, 14 German -kopie/-copy product clones (99.4% identical), 7 kerstcadeau landing variants, duplicated blog posts, 22 thin ?reviews=/?store= pages, indexable geen-categorie archive. 46 of 120 sitemap URLs affected.
findings.recommendation: Trash or 301 duplicates, noindex CPT parameter pages and uncategorised archives, exclude them from the sitemap.

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are all absent.
findings.recommendation: Add the headers in the nginx server block; start CSP in report-only mode.

findings.title: Page caching defeated by cookies and headers
findings.description: Cache-Control: max-age=0, Expires now, wp_woocommerce_session and __cvg_1p_uid cookies set on first anonymous request. TTFB 3.4 to 3.9 s with curl.
findings.recommendation: Full-page cache with cookie exclusions limited to cart/checkout/account; set proper cache headers.

findings.title: Heavy HTML and flat internal linking
findings.description: Average HTML 314 KB (max 503 KB), 27 to 35 stylesheets and 28 to 32 blocking scripts per page; every blog post links to every other post and to the cart page; 14 sitemap URLs have no inbound links.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused builder CSS/JS; replace the all-posts related block with curated cluster links.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Product pages carry 1,000+ words of unique copy; top blog posts exceed 2,000 words
Conversational, readable Dutch; Article + Person schema on posts
Blog post on blind wine tasting already ranks and matches the SERP page type

findings.title: Privacy policy unreachable
findings.description: /privacybeleid/ 301s to the homepage while checkout still references it.
findings.recommendation: Restore the page immediately.

findings.title: Duplicate and near-duplicate content
findings.description: 9 homepage clones, 14 German product clones, 7 kerstcadeau variants (two are 60-word stubs), a -dupliceren post, two republished post pairs, 3 DE and 2 NL Valentine horoscope variants; 30 pages reuse the homepage meta description.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to one URL per topic/occasion with 301s; unique descriptions.

findings.title: Weak E-E-A-T signals
findings.description: Person.url is '#' on 56 posts, no author bio; Organization schema has only an Instagram link; address, VAT, Trustpilot and LinkedIn not linked; trust claims not marked up.
findings.recommendation: Author page for Bart, enriched Organization schema, on-page reviews with Review schema.

findings.title: Thin commercial pages
findings.description: B2B page /eindejaars-en-relatiegeschenken/ is 183 words behind a form despite 151 inbound links; 50 pages under 300 words; category archives are template boilerplate.
findings.recommendation: Add tier pricing, contents, process and trust signals to the B2B page; write category intros.

findings.title: Vocabulary mismatch with search demand
findings.description: Site uses 'wijnspel' and 'het ultieme duel'; buyers search 'wijnproeverij thuis', 'wijnbox cadeau', 'relatiegeschenk wijn', 'teambuilding wijnproeverij'. Flavory absent from 6 of 8 target SERPs; 'wijnbox' appears in no title.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite titles/H1s per findings/sxo.md; publish gift-guide and beginner content.

findings.title: No hub-and-spoke architecture
findings.description: No pillar pages; blog posts link to legacy product URLs that redirect to the homepage while live products receive zero blog links.
findings.recommendation: Six pillars and a 40-row link matrix in findings/cluster.md.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: No page is missing a title tag
Breadcrumbs present sitewide

findings.title: 86 pages without H1, 41 with multiple H1
findings.description: Includes /shop/, both product pages, /shop/bubbelbox/, /flavory-gameplay/, /wijnkiezer/.
findings.recommendation: Add a single H1 to the product and shop templates.

findings.title: 71 pages without meta description; 30 copy the homepage description
findings.description: Includes the B2B page (blank) and /proeverij/ (copied).
findings.recommendation: Unique, intent-matching descriptions starting with commercial pages.

findings.title: Titles carry no search intent
findings.description: Homepage title is 'Home - Flavory'; product titles use 'Het ultieme duel'; 'wijnbox' and 'wijnproeverij thuis' absent from titles.
findings.recommendation: Rewrites in findings/sxo.md.

findings.title: 287 internal links point to redirecting legacy URLs
findings.description: From 114 pages, mostly blog related blocks and buttons.
findings.recommendation: Repoint to live product URLs.

findings.title: 1,019 of 5,207 images lack alt text
findings.description: About 40% on product images.
findings.recommendation: Descriptive alt text with product name and grape pairing.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid Yoast graph on all pages: WebSite, Organization, BreadcrumbList, WebPage, ImageObject
Article + Person on 56 posts; FAQPage on 7 pages with matching visible content

findings.title: No Product/Offer/AggregateRating/Review schema
findings.description: 25 ItemPage URLs have no Product markup; Elementor rating widget emits an orphan Rating node; GTIN buried in SKU string.
findings.recommendation: Enable WooCommerce/Yoast product schema; JSON-LD in findings/schema.md; add gtin13.

findings.title: Organization entity incomplete
findings.description: Name, logo and Instagram only; no address, VAT, contactPoint, founder, LinkedIn or Trustpilot sameAs.
findings.recommendation: Enrich the sitewide Organization node.

findings.title: No LocalBusiness or Review schema on partner-store and customer-review pages
findings.description: 10 ?store= and 12 ?reviews= pages carry only WebPage.
findings.recommendation: Add LocalBusiness and Review types if the pages are kept.

findings.title: Person.url set to '#'
findings.description: 56 author nodes.
findings.recommendation: Set a real author URL in Yoast.

findings.title: Inconsistent Article vs BlogPosting
findings.description: 54 Article, 2 BlogPosting.
findings.recommendation: Standardise on one type.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: CLS is 0.000 to 0.002 on every page tested
Hero image has fetchpriority=high, eager loading and explicit dimensions

metrics.method: Playwright lab, single cold runs, Pixel 7 emulation; PSI and CrUX unavailable

findings.title: Server response 2.9 to 7.3 s on every page
findings.description: TTFB is 4 to 9 times the 800 ms budget and accounts for almost all of LCP; caching bypassed by cookies and headers.
findings.recommendation: Page cache with cookie exclusions, correct headers, OPcache, object cache, CDN.

findings.title: Render-blocking builder CSS/JS
findings.description: 27 to 35 stylesheets and 28 to 32 blocking scripts per page on 314 KB HTML.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused builder assets, defer non-critical JS, inline critical CSS.

findings.title: Third-party tag overload
findings.description: GTM, Meta Pixel, GA4, Microsoft Clarity and an A/B-test tool; 433 to 683 ms blocking time under 4x CPU throttle.
findings.recommendation: Delay non-essential tags until interaction; consolidate through GTM.

findings.title: Heavy page weight and inconsistent lazy loading
findings.description: Homepage and blog transfer 9.4 to 9.7 MB cold; /shop/ lazy-loads 0 of 20 images.
findings.recommendation: Lazy-load below-fold images, compress media, audit videos.

findings.title: INP not measured
findings.description: No synthetic interaction fired; TBT used as proxy.
findings.recommendation: Re-measure with field data once GSC/CrUX is connected.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI crawlers allowed (appropriate for commerce)
llms.txt exists; site is server-rendered; max-snippet unrestricted

findings.title: Homepage definition invisible to main-content extraction
findings.description: Extracted main text is 503 characters of blog teasers; 'Wat is Flavory', 'Hoe werkt het' and price are not captured.
findings.recommendation: Add a 2-sentence definition block near the top of homepage, product pages and FAQ (Dutch examples in findings/geo.md).

findings.title: No Product schema for AI shopping surfaces
findings.description: No structured price or availability to cite.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as schema finding 1.

findings.title: Weak entity signals
findings.description: No Wikidata entry; Organization schema minimal; Trustpilot and LinkedIn not linked; brand-name collision risk.
findings.recommendation: Enrich Organization schema, consistent brand description, consider Wikidata.

findings.title: German section inconsistently localised
findings.description: Untranslated German URLs redirect to Dutch; no hreflang.
findings.recommendation: Translate or remove from German navigation.

findings.title: llms.txt is auto-generated junk
findings.description: Lists test pages and untitled entries; no llms-full.txt. Google ignores llms.txt.
findings.recommendation: Curate it; low priority.

categories.name: Images
what_works: WebP used for hero and OG images
LCP image correctly prioritised

findings.title: 1,019 images without alt text
findings.description: 20% of 5,207 image tags; about 40% on product images.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text, product galleries first.

findings.title: 139 images without width/height
findings.description: Potential layout shift if lazy-loaded later.
findings.recommendation: Add dimensions in the template.

findings.title: Inconsistent lazy loading and heavy media
findings.description: /shop/ lazy-loads 0 of 20 images; homepage cold load 9.4 MB.
findings.recommendation: loading=lazy below the fold; compress and resize media.

categories.name: Sitemap

findings.title: 46 of 120 sitemap URLs are junk
findings.description: Test pages, German clones, kerstcadeau variants, ?reviews=/?store= query URLs, geen-categorie; /de/shop-2/ listed twice; invalid <loc>#</loc> in author-sitemap.xml.
findings.recommendation: Yoast: disable author sitemap, exclude Reviews/Store CPTs, trash test pages; target about 76 URLs.

findings.title: Announcement bar messages overlap on mobile
findings.description: Carousel transition renders two texts at once (blogpost_mobile.png).

findings.title: Add-to-cart below the fold on mobile product pages

findings.title: Oversized mobile header

findings.title: /de/start/ never reaches network idle

findings.title: No cookie-consent banner observed

findings.recommendation: Verify consent mode for BE/NL visitors.

categories.name: E-commerce
what_works: Server-rendered price and add-to-cart; unique product copy; cart noindexed; add-to-cart parameters blocked

findings.title: German shop is 74% duplicate
findings.description: 14 of 19 DE product URLs are -kopie/-copy clones, indexable and in the sitemap.
findings.recommendation: 301 to originals, remove from sitemap, fix internal links.

findings.title: Legacy product URLs redirect to homepage
findings.description: 26 URLs, 287 internal links.
findings.recommendation: Redirect map in findings/ecommerce.md.

findings.title: Seasonal pages fragmented
findings.description: 7 kerstcadeau pages plus 3 posts; Valentine variants in NL and DE; Valentine product slug still carries -10-korting.
findings.recommendation: One evergreen URL per occasion per locale.

findings.title: Merchant Center not possible
findings.description: No Product schema, GTIN field, shipping or returns markup.
findings.recommendation: Product schema with gtin13, shippingDetails and MerchantReturnPolicy; feed via WooCommerce.

findings.title: B2B page hides pricing
findings.description: 183 words, quote form only, no meta description, title 'Offerte aanvraag - Flavory'.
findings.recommendation: Show tier pricing, MOQ, personalisation, client logos.

findings.title: Insufficient data; thin profile signal
findings.description: Absent from the Common Crawl web graph while comparable Belgian retailers appear; none of 4 checked partner stores link to flavory.wine; Moz/Bing not configured.
findings.recommendation: Stockist links, Belgian gift guides, team-building directories, press, bloggers; add a Moz key for monitoring.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Enable full-page caching with WooCommerce session cookie excluded outside cart/checkout; fix Cache-Control/Expires; verify OPcache and PHP 8.x
Enable Product/Offer/AggregateRating schema (WooCommerce core or Yoast WooCommerce SEO); add gtin13 05430004293071
Restore /privacybeleid/
Replace catch-all 301-to-homepage with real 404s
Retarget 26 legacy URLs to live products and fix 287 internal links
Trash or 301 the 9 test pages, 14 German clones, -dupliceren post and 6 kerstcadeau variants
Make /de/ serve or redirect to /de/start/; noindex or remove /en/ pages

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add hreflang nl/de/x-default for translated pairs
Yoast sitemap hygiene: disable author sitemap, exclude Reviews/Store CPTs, noindex geen-categorie (target ~76 URLs)
Rewrite titles, meta descriptions and H1s for homepage, product pages, B2B page and /proeverij/ using 'wijnproeverij thuis', 'wijnbox', 'relatiegeschenk wijn', 'teambuilding wijnproeverij'
Add H1s to product/shop templates; write the 71 missing meta descriptions
Add HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, report-only CSP in nginx
Defer third-party tags, lazy-load below-fold images, add dimensions and alt text
Fix announcement-bar overlap, sticky mobile add-to-cart, smaller mobile header, debug /de/start/ hang
Enrich Organization schema (address, VAT, contactPoint, founder, LinkedIn, Trustpilot); fix Person.url; author page

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Build 6 pillar pages and re-slot 28 posts as spokes; curated related links (matrix in findings/cluster.md)
Merge duplicate post pairs and seasonal variants; one evergreen URL per occasion per locale; rename Valentine product slug
Publish gift-guide listicle and beginner guide; add 2-sentence definition blocks for AI citability
Pull Trustpilot reviews on-page with Review schema; LocalBusiness schema and outbound links on partner pages
Link building: stockists, Belgian gift guides, team-building directories, bloggers, press, Unizo
Finish or prune the German section so no German URL redirects to Dutch
Curate llms.txt

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect GSC, GA4 and a PageSpeed API key for field data
Capture a drift baseline after Phase 1; re-run monthly
Re-measure LCP/TTFB after caching; target LCP under 2.5 s mobile
Track rankings for wijnproeverij thuis, wijnspel, wijnbox cadeau, blind wijn proeven, relatiegeschenk wijn, teambuilding wijnproeverij, origineel cadeau wijnliefhebber
Bing Webmaster Tools + IndexNow; Moz or Ahrefs key for backlinks

data_limitations: Google Search Console, GA4, CrUX and PageSpeed Insights unavailable (no credentials; keyless PSI quota exhausted) - performance is lab-only
Moz and Bing backlink APIs not configured - backlinks assessed via Common Crawl and direct verification only
No drift baseline existed for the URL
Brand-mention checks on Google AI Overviews, Bing and DuckDuckGo could not be performed
